optimized_sql:
SELECT d_year, brand_id, brand, sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT ss_filtered.d_year,
           fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
           fi.i_brand AS brand,
           SUM(ss_filtered.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_sales_price, dt.d_year
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim dt ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
        WHERE dt.d_moy = 11
    ) AS ss_filtered
    JOIN (
        SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
        FROM item
        WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
    ) AS fi ON ss_filtered.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ss_filtered.d_year, fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_brand
    ORDER BY ss_filtered.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
) AS pre_agg
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
